notes.title: Eternal Destiny: Big Update & New DLC "The Attribute Sanctuaries"
notes.content:
[h1]Free Update[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Level Cap Breaker[/b]: Now you can increase your cards' levels to a maximum of 1000 by winning Level Cap Breaker battles! Additional skills will be obtained when your card level reaches 100, 500, and 1000.
[*][b]Attribute Slot & Super Slot[/b]: Attribute slot such as water and flame and super slots with double-strength effect have been added! They are available in Challenge mode, Level Cap Breaker, and the new DLC.
[*][b]New Commander Battle[/b]: Like a minesweeper, now you can obtain
 various items by winning the new commander battle!
[*][b]Challenge Mode[/b]: Challenge mode now open with new three levels.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23341885/858c10f3df5f41e7e6ec0fde0c00074474620ca4.jpg[/img]


[h1]DLC "The Attribute Sanctuaries"[/h1]
[list][*]Dungeon: Attribute Sanctuaries - Easy (16 Attributes)
[*]Dungeon: Attribute Sanctuaries - Normal (16 Attributes)
[*]Dungeon: Attribute Sanctuaries - Hard (16 Attributes)
[*]Bonus: Unevolved Card Set from Ranking Mode[/list]
* Many cards that do not appear in standard card packs are also introduced in this DLC.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/638950/Eternal_Destiny__The_Attribute_Sanctuaries/

notes.title: Eternal Destiny : Closed Beta Announcement
notes.content:
Hi all Eternal Destiny fans ːsylphyːːinfinitasacramentː

We are happy to announce the completely new and final update + final DLC to the game which includes [i]new battle mode, level cap breaker and new attribution fields![/i]
As this update changes system quite drastically, we'd like to get the opinion of a few selected members of the community and eventually adjust based on their suggestions before the release. 

For anyone who would like to participate, please respond to this news.

We will be selecting a few participants among those responses and PM for this closed beta. The closed beta is currently planned to start middle of April.
* Please accept our friend request when we send

Cheers!
ːcybersːEternal Destiny teamːcybersː

notes.title: Eternal Destiny: A Christmas present for you! (update)
notes.content:
Time to get your deck ready for Christmas! Today we bring you a Christmas update!

[h1]Goddess - CPU Battle is Available[/h1]
CPU Battle in Goddess mode is now available! You can obtain [b]six kinds of 5-star rare cards with the non-evolved/evolved/super evolved for each![/b]
[list]
    [*]Easy： Clear "Scenario 10"
    [*]Normal： Clear all five DLCs
    [*]Hard： Clear on Easy and Normal 
[/list]
Since we're still preparing the newest DLC, please try on Easy first, and get ready for the next update!


[h1]Extra Dungeon: The Tune of X'mas[/h1]
Can't wait for Christmas? Here is a brand new dungeon where you can challenge cute Christmas fairies and get Christmas themed cards! 
But be careful, they are pretty strong despite their cute appearance... ;)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23341885/708a92e3b0beaffe47c24a3145fdba9ecaa6a852.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23341885/154c50b1fc484f5fa2c090d9936109dd4aabec4f.png[/img]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Eternal Destiny: addition of the new dungeon "Gathering of Gods" and new config!
notes.content:
Thank you all for playing Eternal Destiny!

[h1]Update Content[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New Extra Dungeon: Gathering of Gods
    [*]New Extra Config is available
    [*]Bug fixes and Improvements
[/list]

[h1]Extra Dungeon: Gathering of Gods[/h1]
The fifth Goddess, the "Goddess of Life", is now available! Explore the dungeons, raise her level and get a beautiful bonus illustration!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23341885/3773d36a8a4dadaea099d8ae8c355d71359b8776.png[/img]

[h1]Extra Config[/h1]
"Extra Config" has been added and lets you set up a number of heavily requested options, including "Auto Dungeon" to explore the dungeons even faster and a number of options to adjust amount of gold/experience you gain in game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23341885/3498fea8ab200d181b2dd7f73beb308106bc12cd.jpg[/img]

Note: More options will become available as you clear extra dungeons. Some options unlock by clearing DLC extra dungeons.

[h1]Bug fixes and Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now to continue to the game even if there is a problem playing the opening video
[*]Fixed a bug which prevented you from getting a trophy when you get a Goddess
[/list]

notes.title: Eternal Destiny: addition of the "Goddess" mode and new dungeon "Mayohiga"
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Eternal Destiny!

[h1]Update Content[/h1]
[list]
    [*]NEW! Goddess system
    [*]New Dungeon: Mayohiga
[/list]

[h1]Goddess System[/h1]

"Invoke a Goddess every few turns and let her use her skills to help you"
This is how the new Goddess system works.

Choose your favorite Goddess from the three available and let this powerful partner help you. Use the Goddess stones you get from online battles in "Goddess' Stone" or from the store to learn new skills.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23341885/1b874b77da492fc4c8005485636f118b9ed5398c.jpg[/img]

Some skills will unlock new graphics from your Goddess, and once you get all variations you will unlock a special bonus appearance for her! (Added to the Gallery too)

Good luck raising your Goddess and getting her best variation♪

notes.title: Eternal Destiny: Brand new "Super Commander" & Chinese are now available!
notes.content:
[h1]New feature: "Super Commander"[/h1]
Evolve your commander into a "Super Commander" by using [b]"Marshal Wand"[/b], which you can earn in Online Mode!
You can purchase one in the game's Item Store too.

[h1]Added Chinese[/h1]
[b]Chinese (Simplified/Traditional)[/b] were officially added, which will heat up the rankings!

[h1]EXTRA Dungeon "Tower of Time and Greed" now available[/h1]

notes.title: Eternal Destiny : Steam Trading Cards, new Card Pack and Extra dungeon as well as a better matching system
notes.content:
It has already been a month since the release of Eternal Destiny, I hope you have enjoyed it so far. Here comes a big update to make it even more enjoyable!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/377880/extras/news_0525.jpg[/img]

[h1]<Update Content>[/h1]
[b]Trading Cards![/b]
Trading cards have been added in response to your fervent requests!

[b]New Card Pack: Female Transformation[/b]
Famous Japanese ghosts and monsters have been made into cute girls! The Female Transformation card pack is now available from the in-game shop.

[b]New Extra Dungeon: Tower of Time and Experience[/b]
A special dungeon where leveling up is particularly easy.

[b]Online Matching: play while waiting[/b]
After creating a game room to wait for other players, you can now go and play other modes and the game will let you know when another player enters your room. No more waiting in an empty room!

[b]Challenge: Score details button[/b]
After your score is sent, you can now check the details.

[b]Adding an opening movie[/b]

[b]and other small fixes[/b]

[h1]<RPG Maker Collaboration event>[/h1]
Free resource based on Eternal Destiny for RPG Maker!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/377880/extras/news_0525.png[/img]

This pack includes:
[list][*]12 walking sprites
[*]Bust and Face graphics for dialogue scenes[/list]
Let's make your own original story RPG featuring Arisa or Sylphy!

store.steampowered.com/app/476050
store.steampowered.com/app/476041
※RPG Maker VX Ace or RPG Maker MV on Steam is required.

notes.title: Card Battler, Eternal Destiny, is coming to Steam on April 21st!
notes.content:
At Degica, we like variety. We like to keep things fresh. We have to bring you the new hotness. That's why we are pleased to announce that Office 5656’s card battler, Eternal Destiny, is coming to Steam on April 21, 2016! This is Degica's first card game, but it's not our first rodeo. We know how to pick them, and we picked a good one...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/377880
Earth: the Millennium of humans has approached its end. History has come to a halt. (That can't be good.) Demons, angelic Kells, and human Cybers are in a three-way conflict with no end in sight. Weary of fighting, people have placed their hopes on the Infinita Sacrament, said to have the power to change the world. An independent organization, “The Agency”, was created to search for it. 
 
Who will obtain the Infinita Sacrament and take command of the next Millennium? The future is shrouded in dark mystery. You are the newest Agent.
 
Eternal Destiny is an epic card game inspired by myths, legends, and H.P. Lovecraft, featuring 500+ cards with fluid animation and voice acting!

The future may be "shrouded in dark mystery", but I'm pretty sure its your destiny to play this game. This crystal ball gets really good reception. (Plus, I've got an unlimited plan, so let's look further.) What else do I see?
 
You'll pick sides and choose your favorite faction, because you like to live dangerously. You'll collect 500+ cards inspired by famous myths, legends, and H.P. Lovecraft (dude knew what's spooky), all with professional voice acting and eye-catching animation featuring cute, strong, and sexy girls. You'll find it easy to learn with strategic depth below the surface. You'll evolve your cards by stacking them and defeat your enemies by combining cards with various skills, abilities, and attributes. (I heard you're a big fan of attributes!) You'll keep coming back for the visual-novel storytelling of story mode and to leave your friends crying in online-mode defeat. You'll explore dungeon mode, level up, and obtain rare cards. You'll unlock exclusive art as you play...
 
Whew, it's exhausting being so precognitive. Anyway, the spirits clearly want you to play Eternal Destiny. Don't be a spiritual party-pooper. Head over to the Steam page and add it to your wishlist!
